Hannah: Heads-up  scheduling a terraform apply in the release quiet window tomorrow 02:45 UTC. Scope: route updates + IAM trust tweak. Planning single-region canary then roll. Any blockers? :wave:
Marco: No blockers. Please pin required_providers in root and create a tfstate snapshot before apply. Also keep per-region apply <=20m.
deploybot: change window reserved by @Hannah for 2025-11-25 02:45 UTC  no overlapping deploys allowed. Required checks: tf fmt, tf validate, plan approval.
infra-bot: detached terraform plan ready  summary: adds=4 changes=2 deletes=0. Notable: prod route update, iam role principal change. plan: https://ci.internal/plans/1961234567
Hannah: Proposed provider pin to add to root module:
```hcl
erraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws" version = "~> 4.74" }
  }
}
```
Marco: I'll own the provider pin + plan approval. Can someone volunteer for canary validation?
oncall: I'll standby for rollback execution. Set triggers and notify me if thresholds hit.
Hannah: Rollback triggers: p95 latency +30% or 5xx spike >0.5% sustained 10m during canary. infra-bot please snapshot tfstate and tag with release id.
infra-bot: snapshot created -> s3://redwood-backups/2025-11-25/release-1961234567.tfstate.gz
Hannah: Owners: Hannah=release owner/runbook, Marco=provider pin & approver, oncall=rollback executor, canary validation=unassigned (volunteers welcome). I'll post final runbook tonight and lock merges 30m before window. :lock:
